selection.status: research screening convention registered by the task book (not a device / supervisor acceptance criterion)
selection.aggregation: mean of the noise repetitions per phase block -> equal-weight mean over phase blocks; sigma 0 separate (one image per phase, never mixed)
selection.three_surface_rule: candidate must pass on all three surfaces; score = min over surfaces of the per-surface global C_tau mean; max wins
tie_breaks: keep fixed nominal reference (dots D_r1_p8x6, lines L_w0.5_s8) inside the tie band
min of per-image max global point RMSE
selection.no_candidate: report "no qualified candidate under this requirement"; best failing reference may be listed, never called a recommendation
selection.families: dots and lines separately; only DF / P4; A3 diagnostic arms never enter; only jointly measured conditions, no interpolation
selection.blocks_not_ci: four-block range is not a confidence interval; old and new phases are never pooled

holdout.slots: per condition and family at most 2 configurations: the three-surface preferred configuration (§6) + the fixed nominal reference (dots D_r1_p8x6, lines L_w0.5_s8); identical -> one; none qualified -> reference only, flagged
holdout.images: <= 4 conditions x 2 families x 2 configurations x 3 surfaces x 4 new phases x 2 new noise realisations = 384
holdout.claim: replication in the tested conditions with new phases of the same position domain and new noise; not out-of-domain, not a real experiment, not a continuous optimum
holdout.verdict: same screening level; difference to the reference < -2 pp -> advantage not replicated; no replacement candidate; no regret bound to the full grid

rules.a3_rule: PSF = 1: s* = s0 (negative control). PSF > 1: among the frozen five P4_C3_cal nodes >= s0 choose the node maximising unit-peak analytic ridge response R(w_px, node, psf_true) / noise coefficient c(node); ties (relative 1e-12) -> smaller node. Inputs: registered line width and PSF only (never C_tau, truth error or wrong ids). Diagnostic rule on finite nodes, not an optimal detector.

subray.warning: |Delta_w(1x1)| >= 2 pp and 3x3 inside +-2 pp or sign change; or |change of Delta_w| >= 5 pp; or a new confirmed wrong id

layers.feature: expected / detected / candidate rejections by code / accepted / c / w / u (sample unit = feature of one image)
layers.surface: 1 - Cvalid (no support), Cvalid - Ctau (supported, error > tau), Ctau (accurate); same node denominator

p4_table_bound.source_default_table: m4_lines.STEGER_NOISE_COEF (three nodes) NOT used: P4_C3_cal passes the five-node table

A2.merging_sign_definition: expected visible dots whose nearest candidate component is shared with another expected dot (image-side nearest assignment)
A2.valley_definition:
camera-side gap: on the stored sigma-0 images (M10, block 0) the minimum grey value on the straight segment between two expected
neighbouring dot images (cross-epipolar neighbours, image distance < 1.5 x median neighbour distance) / the mean of the two dot peaks.
Noise-free single examples only (sigma 0 exists only on M10 block 0); describes the signal distribution, not an algorithmic decision.

A4_band_rule.definition:
MODEL-PREP-06A A4 (should): illumination bridge and bands, stored data only.

bridge   MODEL-PREP-05 UNIFORM (g = 0.75) and NOMINAL levels (glob_Ctau, rep -> block -> four-block mean) against the section-5 (S5-ALIGN-05)
         condition summary of the SAME configuration and front end (DF dots, P4 lines; 8 phases there, 4 blocks here; aggregate levels only,
         never paired). The equivalent noise sigma / g lies between measured S5 levels -> linear interpolation as an approximate display, the
         measured anchors are listed. Light-weighted gain = MODEL-PREP-05 received_light_ratio (shaded intensity of the FOV hits after gain /
         before gain; stage: before PSF, clipping and noise) - it is exactly 0.75 for UNIFORM; for the gradients it is reported, not assumed.
bands    expected positions defined by the stored expected set of the case (lines: reference rows ref_xyz; dots: expected visible dots
         exp_xy / exp_in_image), identical for the paired NOMINAL / UNIFORM / GRAD_X / GRAD_Y cases of one (configuration, surface, block, sigma,
         rep) (asserted). Band of a position = gain of the GRADIENT field at its (x, y) (mp3_forward.gain), endpoints registered before the
         first band output (protocol A4.band_rule). Per band: expected count, recovered with correct id under GRAD, UNIFORM and NOMINAL at the
         SAME positions. Pooled per block over surfaces and reps, then the four-block mean / range.
